newsitem.title: USA: Lotto World no longer listed on Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Lotto World no longer listed on Nasdaq.

text.p: Lotto World Inc said Wednesday trading in its common shares will be conducted on the over-the-counter Bulletin Board, and its common stock will no longer be listed on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
The company said it is continuing to seek capital to fund current and future operations and that it is in the process of negotiating capital investments with several firms.
The company said it will "continue every effort to conserve available capital" since it cannot assure a deal will be completed.
LottoWorld also said it has responded to a bid from the California Lottery to publish a minimum of 1.8 million copies per month of a California Lottery Digest magazine under an exclusive contract.
It expects the California Lottery will award the contract to the winning bidder within 90 days.
